failure.summary: The first SelectedTaskOperation/resolver draft did not narrow a possibly undefined current Skill, had not yet registered SELECTED_TASK_OPERATION_INVALID, and represented optional lifecycle fields incompatibly with exactOptionalPropertyTypes.
